about_the_game:
A Tower Bound by Gods. A Defender Bound by Duty.

Runic Tower is a 3rd-person roguelike tower defense game where you fight to protect a living tower from relentless invaders. When the tower falls, the cycle begins again — each run forging new strategies, unlocking powers, and unveiling the dark forces behind the siege.

🛡️ Defend in Depth – Face waves of cunning enemies, from agile bandits to ritual-bound monstrosities, each with unique AI behaviors, abilities, and tactics.

⚔️ Evolve Your Arsenal – Discover, combine, and upgrade abilities through a modular system designed for experimentation — or break the rules entirely with rare, reality-bending runes.

♻️ Die, Learn, Repeat – Runs end when the tower is destroyed, not when you fall. Return to the fight with new upgrades, meta-progression, and knowledge of your foes.

🌿A Living World – Every faction tells a story through combat. Bandits cut deals in the shadows, cultists bind horrors to their will, and monstrous Covenant creatures stalk the battlefield.

Key Features

  • 3rd-person roguelike tower defense hybrid

  • Highly modular ability system with endless build possibilities

  • Distinct enemy factions with unique AI and tactics

  • Endless ability synergies

  • Atmospheric, lore-rich world with dark fantasy and Lovecraftian undertones

content_descriptors.notes: The game will have spells and abilities which harm enemies in the game. This can vary from explosions, magical missiles and deadly venoms.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (6 GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: (SSD recommended)

short_description: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!
